what: netaudio's channel list reads (0x2400 TX, 0x3400 RX) to a device that announces ARC 2.8.9 (start code 0x2809): the first page and a following page, and the reply dstack v0.6.101 gave to a following page.
recorded: 2026-11-12, dstack #237. The requests are encoded offline with netaudio 0.4.2's own encoder (netaudio.core build_command, protocol 0x2809, message ids set to 0x0201 to 0x0204), not captured from the network. The reply is the one netaudio 0.4.2 logged from a dstack-dev v0.6.101 with 64 TX and 64 RX channels on the test box ("tx channel page rejected (inventory: invalid page (channel page made no progress))"); its sequence is netaudio's. No name is in any frame.

asks.0x2400 first: TX channels from 1 to the end, media selector 1
asks.0x2400 next: TX channels from 33 to the end, media selector 3 (the media type of the last record netaudio read)
asks.0x3400 first: RX channels from 1 to the end, media selector 1
asks.0x3400 next: RX channels from 9 to the end, media selector 3

layout.request: header (start code, length, sequence, opcode, 0), then body bytes 6-7 = 1, 8-9 the media selector, 10-11 the first channel (from 1), 12-13 the last (0: to the end), 18-23 = 83 02 83 06 03 10 (netaudio's own; Dante Controller sends zeros there).
layout.selector: netaudio asks the first page with selector 1 and every following page with the media type code of the last record it read (3, audio). Two real 2.8.9 devices answer selector 3 byte for byte as selector 1 (0x2400, 0x3400 and 0x3600), and selector 2 or 0x8003 with an empty page.
layout.progress: netaudio (netaudio-core channel_inventory.rs) reads `count` records of each page (body byte 7), each identified by (media type, media-local id). Every page after the first must add a record it has not seen, else it refuses the whole list ("channel page made no progress"). On status 0x8112 it asks the next page from the lowest media-local id it has not seen; on status OK the list is complete.
layout.reply_v0_6_101: status OK, a body of 8 zero bytes: no record, so the page after the first added none.
